description: This Java class, NoControlCharactersValidator, extends AbstractPatternValidator and provides functionality to validate character sequences by ensuring they do not contain control characters, using a specific regex pattern. It includes a static factory method for instantiation and is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.validation package.
